instructions: Read this roster before every scheduled reading run; work only inside the registered slot.
At run start, set run_status to running and record the actual start time, current book, and slot in agent-communication.md.
At run end, update run_status, actual end time, book_completion, and a minimal output reference in both this roster and agent-communication.md.

At a recovery slot, skip if the same-day primary run completed; resume if it is confirmed failed, interrupted, or blocked. If its status is still running or unclear, verify it is no longer active before resuming; otherwise do not overlap and record the unresolved state.
Same-book work from multiple slots on one date is merged into a single date note.
If an agent misses a slot, record that fact; do not overlap another agent's window or claim the missed run happened.
Use unknown/needs-confirmation rather than guessing a book, completion state, or execution result.
This public file records only minimal coordination metadata; never include passwords, tokens, private messages, or book-note content.
